description: 16x16 boxy robot facing RIGHT, feet on row 15, transparent bg, 1px k outline on all parts. Head: box cols 3-12, rows 4-10, casing W; w shading on right column and bottom row (light from upper left). Screen inset 1px, shifted right: F rectangle cols 6-11, rows 6-9. Eyes: two 1x2 T pixels (cols 8 and 10, rows 7-8); 3px G smile on row 9; one T glare pixel at screen top-left. Antenna: q stalk at col 8, rows 2-3; 1px O tip at row 1 (the only orange). Body: w box cols 5-10, rows 11-12, one G chest light. Legs: two stubby q legs 2px wide, rows 13-14; 3px feet on row 15 with k soles. idle0: as described. idle1: head, antenna and body down 1px, legs squash 1px, feet fixed; antenna tip T (blink). Walk: move0 front leg forward 1px, back leg back 1px, both feet down. move1 legs together, body up 1px, back foot lifted 1px. move2 mirror of move0 (back leg forward). move3 legs together, body up 1px, front foot lifted 1px. Antenna tip O in move0/move2, T in move1/move3.

provenance.judgeReason: Variant 1 keeps the legs attached to the body in every frame, so the walk cycle stays consistent. Variant 2's frames 4 and 6 show legs floating detached from the body, which reads as stray pixels at small size.
